user_question: For an existing MU long, compare hold, add, trim, and exit under a downside scenario when liquidity and thesis-pressure inputs are incomplete.

input_refs.description: Synthetic SHA-25 fixture: existing MU long, downside price move, missing liquidity, and incomplete thesis-pressure inputs.

assumptions: This fixture grades explanation quality and uncertainty disclosure, not live trading accuracy.
The simulator must compare actions without treating the ranking as an executable order.
Missing liquidity and thesis-pressure inputs should reduce confidence and be visible in the output.

gold_output.simple_thesis: Scenario comparison can identify how hold, add, trim, and exit change exposure and downside loss, but incomplete liquidity and thesis-pressure inputs prevent an action from being approval-ready.
gold_output.embedded_macro_exposure: Semiconductor cycle, AI memory demand, equity beta, liquidity, and market-risk appetite.

mispricing.why_consensus_is_wrong: Cannot be concluded from the simulator inputs alone.

catalyst_or_reason_now.expected_timeframe: Immediate decision-support review; no execution without separate approval.

source_evidence: Synthetic SHA-25 scenario simulator request: candidate actions, downside price move, missing liquidity, and incomplete thesis-pressure inputs

invalidation.timeframe: Before any financial action is staged.
invalidation.implication: The simulator output remains decision support only and should route to research or review.

evidence_for.claim: The simulator can compare exposure and loss mechanics deterministically.
evidence_for.support: Hold keeps exposure unchanged, add increases downside loss, trim reduces downside loss, and exit removes the position exposure in the modeled scenario.

evidence_against.claim: The action ranking is not enough to execute.
evidence_against.support: Liquidity and thesis-pressure inputs are incomplete, so uncertainty must be disclosed and approval-gated execution remains separate.

gold_output.confidence_reason: Moderate-low because mechanics are deterministic, but explanation quality depends on disclosing missing liquidity, thesis pressure, and execution approval boundaries.

sizing_context.add_conditions: Do not add until liquidity, stress loss, and thesis-pressure inputs are complete and policy gates pass.

sizing_context.portfolio_constraints: Sizing cannot be made approval-ready without book value, exposure, risk, and policy-gate context.
